title: This Classic PS1 Star Wars Game Just Got a Neat PS5 Enhancement
summary:
Go back to The Phantom Menace for a Platinum.

The video game adaptation of Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace from the PS1 generation looks to be getting a facelift on PS5 and PS4 in the form of a new Trophy list.

When it launched on PS Plus Premium a few years ago, The Phantom Menace came without a set of Trophies. Now, though, Exophase is pulling Trophy lists as of a few hours ago. Expect the ports to be updated with these Trophies in the coming days — and yes, it does have a Platinum Trophy.
